evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the recovery behavior (new track report) following the decorrelation event.

evidence_cards.content: C2 JUs shall not automatically correlate two tracks if local/remote data held indicates that both tracks are locally derived real-time tracks (i.e., being updated with local positional data).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies a specific exception condition (both tracks locally derived) where automatic correlation is prohibited, defining an error/prevention path for the use case.

evidence_cards.content: C2 JUs shall not automatically correlate two tracks if either track has the Strength field set to a value greater than 1; however, systems shall not inhibit correlation if either track has Strength set to No Statement.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies another exception condition based on the Strength field value that prevents automatic correlation, defining a validation failure path.

evidence_cards.content: The correlation shall be deemed to have failed if no J7.0 (ACT = 0) is received for the dropped TN after a period of 60 seconds from the transmission of the correlation request and all associated processing for the correlation shall be cancelled.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the exception flow where the correlation process fails due to a timeout condition (lack of acknowledgement message), resulting in cancellation.

evidence_cards.content: If the R² JU identifies that an ID conflict exists, the operator shall be alerted and the local ID data shall continue to be reported in the appropriate surveillance message, with the Identity Difference Indicator set to value 1.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the exception handling path for R² units upon detecting an ID conflict, specifying operator alerting and continued reporting with a specific indicator state.

evidence_cards.content: For R² JUs identifying an ID conflict, the conflict will be resolved by manual means.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the recovery mechanism for the exception flow, indicating that automatic resolution is not performed and manual intervention is required.

evidence_cards.content: NonR² JUs may follow actions where, if a conflict is indicated, the unit shall inhibit transmission of the J7.0 (ACT = 1) until the surveillance message is received with the Identity Difference Indicator set to value 0.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an alternative exception handling path for Non-R² units involving the inhibition of specific message transmissions pending a clearance signal.

evidence_cards.content: C2 JUs receiving or generating a J7.2 message with the RV field set to value 2 (Correlation Rejection) shall not automatically originate a request with the same Retained TN and Dropped TN for a period of 2(1-10,1) minutes.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific exception flow constraint where automatic re-request is inhibited following a rejection event.

evidence_cards.content: When a correlation request is rejected for a manual correlation, the JU originating the request shall provide an operator alert as a cue to conduct voice coordination.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the required system response (operator alert) for the exception condition of a rejected manual correlation request.

evidence_cards.content: An operator alert in the event of the rejection of an automatic correlation shall be a system option.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Distinguishes the handling of automatic vs. manual correlation rejections, noting that alerts for automatic rejections are optional rather than mandatory.

evidence_cards.content: After acceptance of a manual correlation the resulting track shall not be the subject of automatic decorrelation processing for a period of 5 minutes.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes a post-exception stability period preventing immediate automatic reversal of a manually resolved conflict.

evidence_cards.content: When erroneous codes are detected and there are no other valid codes available or changes are inhibited (as in Mode II code reporting), the C2 JU must have the capability to delete or clear the erroneous codes so that the interface can return to a No Data status for the specified track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific exception handling path (deleting/clearing erroneous codes) required when standard resolution is not possible due to lack of valid data or inhibition rules.

evidence_cards.content: Any JU capable of maintaining IFF/SIF data shall automatically set the designated mode(s) for the specified track to 'No Data' status upon initiation or receipt of a J7.5 (ACT = 0) message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the automated system response (state reset) triggered by a specific clearing message during error handling.

evidence_cards.content: When an operator receives an IFF/SIF data conflict alert as required in Table 4.7-5, the operator shall have the following manual actions at his disposal for attempting resolution of the difference: (1) Update local data manually or verify automatic inputs; (2) Initiate J7.5 (ACT = 0) Clear IFF/SIF message (any mode); (3) Initiate J7.5 (ACT = 1) IFF/SIF Difference Report message (any mode); (4) Change local data to agree with remote data except in the case of Mode II code; (5) Decorrelate the local data from the remote data, causing the assignment of a new track number to local data; (6) Clear operator alert (any mode).

source_locations.location: Page 122 (second image), paragraph d and list items (1)-(6)

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This provides the specific exception handling paths available to the operator when an identity conflict or difference condition is detected during correlation processing, which constitutes the exception_flow for this use case.

evidence_cards.content: If the above actions (Change local ID/Exercise Indicator, Transmit ID Difference Report, Confirm restriction, or Conduct voice coordination) result in resolution of the ID conflict, the TN to be retained shall be tested for decorrelation in accordance with paragraph 4.4.4.3.2a before executing the correlation, except the test shall be conducted only once.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines the specific recovery behavior and return-to-main-flow condition after an operator resolves an exception (ID conflict). It specifies that a single decorrelation test is required before the system can proceed to execute the correlation.

evidence_cards.content: The correlation shall be deemed to have failed if no J7.0 (ACT = 0) is received for the dropped TN after a period of 60 seconds from the transmission of the correlation request and all associated processing for the correlation shall be cancelled.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This provides the explicit termination state for the exception flow when the 'Transmit ID Difference Report' path is taken but fails to receive a confirmation within the specified time limit, resulting in cancellation.

evidence_cards.content: In cases where a system does not receive a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message and receives no further updates on a remote track, a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message shall not be transmitted, and the system must have the capability to automatically purge those tracks after a specific time interval.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an exception flow for handling missing termination messages (unexpected condition) by suppressing transmission and initiating an automatic purge.

evidence_cards.content: If the locally held Environment/Category of a track is different from the Environment/Category received in a J3.X or a J7.0 (ACT = 1) message for that track, the operator shall be alerted.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an exception condition (data mismatch) and the required system response (alert operator).

evidence_cards.content: The alert for Environment/Category difference shall be provided even in those cases where the received Environment/Category is not implemented.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies a boundary condition for the exception handling (alert persists even if data type is unsupported).

evidence_cards.content: If the local data and the received data differ as to whether the TN is assigned to a point or to a track, the operator shall be alerted.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines another specific exception condition (TN assignment mismatch) triggering an operator alert.

evidence_cards.content: If the Identity Difference Indicator is set to value 1 (indicating an ID conflict), the nonR² unit may either: 1) Follow the actions in Table 4.7-2 but inhibit transmission of the J7.0 (ACT = 1) message until the surveillance message is received with the Identity Difference Indicator reset to value 0, or 2) Take no action with respect to the reported ID, where an operator alert may be provided as a system option.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the exception flow behavior for Non-R² units when an Identity Difference Indicator is set to 1 (conflict state), specifically detailing the inhibition of automatic resolution messages and the optional operator alert.

evidence_cards.content: If the R² JU identifies that an ID conflict exists, the operator shall be alerted and the local ID data shall continue to be reported in the appropriate surveillance message with the Identity Difference Indicator set to value 1. The conflict will be resolved by manual means.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the specific exception handling path for R² Joint Units upon detecting an ID conflict, including the requirement for operator alert and manual resolution.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU shall not automatically correlate two tracks if the Strength field of either track is set to a value greater than 1.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies an exception condition (Strength > 1) that prevents automatic correlation, distinct from identity or Mode II conflicts.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU shall not inhibit correlation if either track has the Strength field set to 'No Statement'.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the recovery behavior for the Strength exception: if the field is set to 'No Statement', the restriction does not apply and correlation proceeds.

evidence_cards.content: If conflicting IDs is the only correlation restriction, the operator shall be alerted. The purpose of this alert is to cue the operator to take one of the following actions: (a) Change the local ID or the Exercise Indicator and ID, thereby allowing automatic correlation; (b) Transmit an ID Difference Report, thereby allowing automatic correlation if the remote ID or Exercise Indicator and ID is changed.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This text defines a specific exception flow where the standard inhibition of correlation (Main Flow Step 3) is overridden by operator intervention. It details the trigger condition ('conflicting IDs is the only correlation restriction') and the recovery path (operator alert leading to data modification or reporting), which fits the definition of an exception handling path distinct from the main success scenario.

evidence_cards.content: Receipt of ID data on a TN for which the receiving JU does not have R² and local positional data is not held will automatically be accepted and the remote ID placed in the database for retention.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an exception flow where identity difference resolution is bypassed due to lack of local data, resulting in automatic acceptance rather than operator intervention or conflict handling.

evidence_cards.content: If the Identity Difference Indicator is set to value 1, the nonR² unit may take no action with respect to the reported ID; an operator alert may be provided as a system option.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines an exception flow where the system inhibits automatic resolution or transmission of conflict reports (J7.0) when the indicator is set to 1, diverging from standard difference resolution logic.

evidence_cards.content: When the Identity Difference Indicator is set to value 1, if the R² JU is directed to automatically reject the remote ID, the system shall discard the message and the track shall continue to be reported with local data.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes an exception handling path for R² units receiving conflicting ID reports under specific indicator conditions, resulting in message discard rather than database update.

evidence_cards.content: When a Platform, Platform Activity or Specific Type value of 0 (No Statement) is received and a non-zero value is held locally, the C2 JU retains the local values as an exception to the rule of accepting remote ID changes.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific data conflict condition where automatic acceptance of remote ID changes is prevented (exception flow), requiring retention of local data.

evidence_cards.content: When an Air Platform value of 6 (Tanker), 7 (Tanker Boom Only), or 8 (Tanker Drogue Only) is held locally and a different value is received, the system treats this as an exception; an operator alert in this situation is optional.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies a specific exception flow for tanker platform types where standard resolution rules do not apply and alerts are optional.

evidence_cards.content: When erroneous codes are detected and there are no other valid codes available or changes are inhibited (as in Mode II code reporting), the system shall have a capability to delete or clear the erroneous codes so that the interface can return to a No Data status for the specified track and its corresponding mode(s).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the exception flow trigger (detection of erroneous codes with no valid alternatives) and the required system response (clear/delete capability to reset to No Data status) for the Manage Track Identity Classification use case.

evidence_cards.content: Any JU capable of originating a J3 message that includes a continuation word containing IFF/SIF data shall also have a capability to manually originate the J7.5 (ACT = 0) message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the manual operator intervention mechanism (J7.5 ACT=0 message origination) required as part of the exception handling path when automatic resolution is not possible due to erroneous codes.

evidence_cards.content: Any JU capable of maintaining IFF/SIF data in its database shall have a capability, upon initiation or receipt of a J7.5 (ACT = 0) message, to automatically set the designated mode(s) for the specified track.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the automated system response to the exception-handling trigger (receipt of J7.5 ACT=0), ensuring the track's identity data is cleared/reset as part of the recovery process.

evidence_cards.content: When an operator receives an IFF/SIF data conflict alert as required in Table 4.7-5 (which includes conflicts triggered by Mode II differences or identity mismatches), the system provides manual resolution actions including: (1) Update local data manually or verify automatic inputs; (2) Initiate J7.5 (ACT = 0) Clear IFF/SIF message; (3) Initiate J7.5 (ACT = 1) IFF/SIF Difference Report message; (4) Change local data to agree with remote data except in the case of Mode II code; (5) Decorrelate the local data from the remote data, causing assignment of a new track number; and (6) Clear operator alert.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines the exception flow for handling identity conflicts that inhibit automatic correlation, providing specific recovery paths available to the operator when the main flow is blocked by a conflict condition.

evidence_cards.content: If the same report is transmitted twice within 30 seconds during TC (Transmit Local Data in J7.5 ACT=1) processing, automatic transmission of the J7.5 ACT=1 message is inhibited and the operator is alerted.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This represents an additional exception condition within the difference resolution process that inhibits automatic action and requires operator intervention, fitting the exception_flow slot.

evidence_cards.content: If the automatic correlation test fails during decorrelation execution, the system shall assign a new TN (TN B) to the local track and report TN B in a J3.2 or J3.3 message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific exception handling path (assignment of new TN) triggered by a failure condition (failed correlation test) within the track management process.

evidence_cards.content: If the R² JU identifies that an ID conflict exists, the operator shall be alerted and the local ID data shall continue to be reported in the appropriate surveillance message, with the Identity Difference Indicator set to value 1; the conflict will be resolved by manual means.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the exception handling path for R² JUs when an ID conflict is detected, specifying alerting and reporting behavior.

evidence_cards.content: If the Identity Difference Indicator is set to value 1 for a non-R² unit, the unit may either: (a) follow the actions in Table 4.7-2 while inhibiting transmission of the J7.0 (ACT = 1) message until a surveillance message is received with the Identity Difference Indicator reset to value 0; or (b) take no action with respect to the reported ID, with an operator alert provided as a system option.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the two exception flow options available to non-R² units when the Identity Difference Indicator is set to 1.

evidence_cards.content: When an operator receives an IFF/SIF data conflict alert, the operator has the following manual actions available for attempting resolution of the difference: (1) update local data manually or verify automatic inputs; (2) initiate a J7.5 (ACT = 0) Clear IFF/SIF message (any mode); (3) initiate a J7.5 (ACT = 1) IFF/SIF Difference Report message (any mode); (4) change local data to agree with remote data except in the case of Mode II code; (5) decorrelate the local data from the remote data, causing assignment of a new track number to the local data; and (6) clear the operator alert (any mode).

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the post-resolution validation step required after manual conflict resolution, ensuring data integrity before correlation proceeds.
